en.h1: What Does CL Mean on a Bosch Washing Machine?
en.description: Bosch identifies CL as the child lock being active on models that use this display message.
en.quick_fix: Use the exact model manual or the marked key control to deactivate Child Lock because the control sequence varies by model (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Bosch identifies CL as the child lock being active on models that use this display message.

Use the exact model manual or the marked key control to deactivate Child Lock because the control sequence varies by model. The code alone confirms no replacement part; dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:

Stop immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load, installation and detergent guidance, empty pockets and keep visible hoses and user-accessible filters clean as the model manual specifies.

Internal sensor, motor, communication and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing CL?
faq_json.answer: Use the exact model manual or the marked key control to deactivate Child Lock because the control sequence varies by model. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset CL by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does CL identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

faq_json.question: Kan jag fortsätta använda maskinen med CL?

faq_json.question: Kan jag återställa CL genom att stänga av?
faq_json.answer: Avstängning är en säkerhetsåtgärd, inte bevis på att felet är löst. Återställ inte maskinen upprepade gånger om koden återkommer.

faq_json.question: Visar CL vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Koden identifierar ett system eller tillstånd, men Bosch service ska diagnostisera den exakta orsaken före beställning.

faq_json.question: Varför behöver Bosch E‑Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch-serier och marknader kan ha olika maskinvara och serviceförfaranden. E‑Nr identifierar rätt dokumentation.

faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte interna ledningar, sensorer eller elektronik. Bosch hänvisar dessa koder till service.

faq_json.question: Kan jag fortsätta använda maskinen med E36?
faq_json.answer: Fotografera hela displayen, dokumentera varje suffix och använd manualen för exakt E‑Nr innan en tömningsåtgärd väljs. Kör inte ett nytt program innan Bosch eller en servicetekniker har bekräftat att det är säkert.

faq_json.question: Kan jag återställa E36 genom att stänga av?
faq_json.answer: Avstängning är en säkerhetsåtgärd, inte bevis på att felet är löst. Återställ inte maskinen upprepade gånger om koden återkommer.

faq_json.question: Visar E36 vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Koden identifierar ett system eller tillstånd, men Bosch service ska diagnostisera den exakta orsaken före beställning.

faq_json.question: Varför behöver Bosch E‑Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch-serier och marknader kan ha olika maskinvara och serviceförfaranden. E‑Nr identifierar rätt dokumentation.

faq_json.question: Kan jag själv testa sensorn?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte interna ledningar, sensorer eller elektronik. Bosch hänvisar dessa koder till service.

en.h1: What Does E42 Mean on a Bosch Washing Machine?
en.description: E42 has no universal definition in Bosch's current public washer code table, so the complete display and exact E-Nr manual are required.
en.quick_fix: Photograph the complete code and contact Bosch with the exact E-Nr; do not infer a motor or control component from E42 alone (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
E42 has no universal definition in Bosch's current public washer code table, so the complete display and exact E-Nr manual are required.

Photograph the complete code and contact Bosch with the exact E-Nr; do not infer a motor or control component from E42 alone. The code alone confirms no replacement part; dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

Test only after correcting an external cause, and never with leakage, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat, electrical fault or severe mechanical noise.
Request service if the code remains or returns. Open no panels and test no internal parts.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Arrange Bosch service if E42 remains or returns after documented external checks. Sensors, motor, pump, door lock, wiring and electronics require model-specific diagnosis.

Stop immediately for leakage near electricity, burning smell, smoke, sparks, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load, installation and detergent guidance, empty pockets and keep visible hoses and user-accessible filters clean as the model manual specifies.

Internal sensor, motor, communication and electronics faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing E42?
faq_json.answer: Photograph the complete code and contact Bosch with the exact E-Nr; do not infer a motor or control component from E42 alone. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset E42 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does E42 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.
